brief:
Israeli airstrikes and artillery bombardment killed at least 11 people in southern Lebanon on Saturday morning, according to Shehab Wire. The military operations targeted populated towns across the region in a sharp escalation of violence that unfolded over several hours beginning early Saturday.

The intense attacks prompted widespread civilian evacuation as residents fled their homes in the south. Roads from the affected areas filled with families seeking safety, with reports indicating significant population movement away from the strike zones as the bombardment continued.
